records.subject: Welcome aboard, Granite Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Glad to have Granite Dynamics on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with no project, no invite, no key milestone and zero tickets. Three Wrenfield emails (d45aa788, 179b9a5b, a7dcc44d) went unanswered; no customer reply anywhere, only an internal watch note (558960f3). Silent, fully disengaged accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One small step for your Wrenfield workspace
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week, so I'll keep this short. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is what makes everything else useful.

If it's helpful, reply with a rough list of what your team is working on this month and I'll walk you through turning it into your first project — or we can do it together on a short call this week, whichever is easier.

Best,
Priya
